decisions.choice: Added a trailing period to the single line in notes.txt.
decisions.whyItMatters: It keeps notes.txt a grammatically complete sentence so the note reads as finished text rather than a truncated fragment, preserving the file's usefulness as accurate notes.

alternatives.option: Leave the line unchanged with no trailing punctuation.
alternatives.consequence: The note would remain readable but look like an unfinished fragment, slightly reducing clarity of the notes.

alternatives.option: Reword or expand the line to add more content.
alternatives.consequence: That would go beyond a small, safe one-line touch-up and risks altering the note's intended meaning.

recommendation.reason: It is the minimal punctuation fix that makes the note read as a complete sentence without changing its meaning.

assumptions: The line's intended meaning is unchanged by adding a period.
notes.txt should remain a single line of notes.
